text: Yes, native forest was deforested in this area in 2025. A total of **13.5 ha** of tree cover was lost, representing **3.9%** of the asset. Of this, **13.1 ha** (97%) was confirmed as native forest, with only a small fraction (0.4 ha) outside mapped forest areas. The loss was detected by the **Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025)** and corroborated by the **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020**, which confirmed 98% of the area was forested in 2020. No planted forest was involved. The event meets the detection thresholds with a minimum area of **0.5 ha** and a **30% tree cover threshold**. No later observations are available, but 2025 is the latest year in the series.
